a.text: I'm telling you upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our original plan only works if two storms in a row miss, about a 4% chance. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so I'm going to take 4 in round 1 instead of operating. That breaks our agreement, and I'd rather say it openly than surprise you. If you also take, the split is random and we may both fall short, so please operate this round. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that to help you build the reserve back up to 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
